scripts.n8n:start: node n8n/init.mjs && docker compose -f n8n/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.n8n:stop: node n8n/init.mjs --env-only && docker compose -f n8n/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.n8n:logs: node n8n/init.mjs --env-only && docker compose -f n8n/docker-compose.yml logs -f n8n
scripts.n8n:export: docker exec n8n sh -c 'rm -f /home/node/workflows/*.json && n8n export:workflow --all --pretty --separate --output=/home/node/workflows'
